scope.identityPrefill: Synthetic first name, last name and email already entered in the UI; no phone, DOB, address, identity document, KYC verification or ToS acceptance.

shortPath: Complete the two exact Auth-only-owned TEST profiles in the visible frontend. Review private Auth/profile evidence; version only the owner marker, original Auth source SHA, journal digest and exact transmission projection digest. Never publish the actor UIDs or profile values.

Review this dedicated module and targeted refusal tests. Add one dedicated manual main-only workflow and activate its closed contract for at most four hours. Never reopen CONNECT_DOCUMENTS_TEST_V1 or import its execution pipeline.
Workflow uses the existing CI STRIPE_TEST_SECRET_KEY plus staging Management/GitHub read credentials. It never reads/writes a Stripe key in Vault, Edge secrets, an artifact or a local workstation.

Runner discovers exactly two existing Auth/profile actors by trusted owner metadata, validates roles/TEST and the reviewed transmission digest, and derives UIDs only in memory. Run once, attempt 1, exact main/source pins and one dispatch. Persist an encrypted atomic intent before each sole provider POST; recheck expiry immediately after checkpoint and before POST. An ambiguous intent stops without retry.
Review the encrypted IDs and real provider rereads, then bind them with a separately reviewed, exact stage-only CAS transaction. This provider module performs no link or onboarding-row mutation.

futureWorkflowRequirements.checkout: exact github.sha, persist-credentials=false, pinned action commit
futureWorkflowRequirements.runtime: Node 24.14.0, builtins only, no npm install/build
futureWorkflowRequirements.credentialScope: Only final operator step env, no shell trace, no secret in argv/output/journal; optional restricted TEST key must already have required permissions, never elevate dynamically.
futureWorkflowRequirements.input: Exactly expected_main_sha + PUBLIC recipient RSA4096 key/fingerprint. Versioned contract contains actors=null, trusted Auth owner/source SHA and projection digests. Runner discovers the exact two UIDs read-only by owner and binds its private runtime manifest in memory. No UIDs, profile values, email, phone or password in GitHub inputs/contract/output.
futureWorkflowRequirements.artifacts: Always upload only encrypted checkpoint and fixed booleans; do not upload plaintext profiles, request bodies, identifiers or provider error bodies.
futureWorkflowRequirements.checkpointLimit: fsync/atomic rename proves the local runner checkpoint before effect, not independent remote durability. A killed runner can lose it before artifact upload. One-dispatch/attempt barrier and provider metadata collisions refuse automatic recreation; recovery is independent read-only reconciliation, never a blind rerun.

allowedTechnicalWebhookEffects.customerCreated: Outside existing platform event allowlist; ignored.
allowedTechnicalWebhookEffects.accountUpdated: TEST classification from exact metadata soignant_id resolves the existing TEST profile. Only technical webhook claim/audit TEST_SKIPPED may be written before early return; no qualification/onboarding/business mutation is authorized.
allowedTechnicalWebhookEffects.precondition: Pin both deployed webhook edge bundles and exact TEST destinations first. Current source alone does not prove the deployment or its secret configuration.
allowedTechnicalWebhookEffects.historicalDisabled: Pin the complete three-endpoint list. Exactly the two known stage endpoints may be enabled. The known historical TEST endpoint to the production URL must remain disabled with API version 2026-03-25.dahlia; never modify/delete/reactivate it.

validationLimits: Draft was not run against Stripe, Supabase or GitHub.
No Express account may be created before the two real frontend TEST profiles exist.
TEST Account objects do not prove authenticated PSC, professional qualification, completed Connect onboarding, physical device behavior or a payment/refund.
No public or private API key values have been read or saved by this preparation.
Dedicated CLI/workflow are local closed drafts only; complete local opening refuses all partial/ambiguous journals before mkdir or handoff. No reconciliation/retry mode exists.

Opaque Auth owner marker/source SHA may be versioned as requested; actor UIDs and all profile values remain private and are derived only in the runner. The current draft keeps owner/source/digests unbound and every readiness/review flag closed.
idempotency: Purpose-scoped stable key hashes Auth owner + exact actor UUID; immutable request SHA-256 is in the encrypted intent. No automatic retry even though Stripe v1 supports idempotency. Keys may be pruned after at least 24h, so they are not a permanent duplicate barrier.
requiredExistingKeyPermissions: Existing CI TEST key must permit Account/Balance/Customers/Accounts/WebhookEndpoints reads and Customer/Account creates. This has not been probed; a rejected call stops without permission elevation or EnableConnect.
uiEvidenceSha256Semantics: SHA-256 of canonical transmissionProjection(current private DB snapshot, exact two-actor manifest): every exact Customer/Express request field plus IDs, Auth owner and both Auth/profile TEST flags. It is not a screenshot/file digest. Compare at FIRST preflight before either POST. No names, emails or phone numbers are bound in this versioned contract.
uidTransport: readOwnedActors: fixed staging identity before read-only owner query; exact cohort=2 with one SOIGNANT and one ADMIN_ETABLISSEMENT, both genuine UI profiles TEST; strict private transmission projection equality. No incoming decryption secret.
reviewCorrections: Full exact three-webhook inventory, exactly the two known stage endpoints enabled and the known historical TEST production-URL endpoint disabled.
uiEvidenceSha256 is the canonical exact transmission projection digest; compare immediately on discovery and the first preflight, never adopt the first observed unreviewed profile.
steps must be a plain object, never an array or non-object; encrypted JSON roundtrip tests assert intents and done provider IDs.
Expiry rechecked after asynchronous intent checkpoint immediately before either POST and before prepared result.
Signed metadata.etablissement_id must equal the establishment UID and be absent on caregiver; common validation covers discovery and every preflight.
Runtime and CLI require ready===true AND canExecute===true. False/missing canExecute refuses before Git/network, including with ready=true.
